description: Two native records describe CAMBER mobile-device road surveys with synchronized GPS and YOLO-based infrastructure-defect detections. Video 60 is reported completed on 14 July 2026, over 0.19km, with four detections and a CSV descriptor. Video 37 is reported on 24 February 2026 with processing pending; its filename refers to 20 February, and the source provides time-limited signed links. They are grouped as separate samples of the named survey series, with dates and processing states retained. A green or black risk label is not independently validated. Only Video 60 metadata and detection CSV descriptors are publicly listed; media, coordinates and detection values were not read. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
